Two units that name the same act at different levels of generality are one entry, settled by the facts; two units that name different acts are two entries and both belong in the answer, however usual a single unit is in the references. Then answer with the units of the entries the facts establish: reuse whole reference units, never a fragment of one, with their exact spelling and the separators the references use.
